note: Microcephaly is reported as an uncommon to moderate feature in MAPK8IP3 cohorts and is explicitly documented in patients with the recurrent p.Arg578Cys missense variant, with missense alleles showing more severe phenotypes than loss-of-function variants.

evidence.text: In a cohort of 13 individuals with de novo MAPK8IP3 variants, growth development was mostly normal, but microcephaly and short stature were documented in individuals harboring the recurrent missense alteration p.Arg578Cys.

evidence.text: A comprehensive cohort of 32 individuals with heterozygous pathogenic MAPK8IP3 variants identified microcephaly among common symptoms, and genotype-phenotype analysis indicated that missense variants were associated with more severe symptoms than predicted loss-of-function alleles.

source.title: Comprehensive Clinical Characteristics, Longitudinal Adaptive Functioning, and Electroencephalogram Activity in MAPK8IP3‐Related Neurodevelopmental Disorder
source.quote: Common symptoms included cognitive impairment, hypotonia, motor difficulties, strabismus, microcephaly, and attention deficits... Missense variants were associated with more severe symptoms than LOF variants.
